regime_schedule.source: 37 emitted state changes, time-ordered with a 30-day minimum gap
regime_schedule.matched_rule: the dynamic arms get exactly as many refreshes as the calendar arms. The model chooses WHERE they fall, never how many, because a method allowed to look more times is not being compared on timing (guide 10.5)

compute_match.rule: same refresh count and same training memory. Only the timing differs, which is the contribution being measured (guide 10.1 arm C: 'training memory giữ như A')

controls.RISK_ONLY: the benefit is exposure timing, not parameter selection
controls.CALENDAR_MATCHED: the benefit is extra search compute, not better timing
controls.BANK_CALENDAR: the benefit is having a bank at all, not switching within it on regime
controls.STATE_PLACEBO: the benefit is switching on ANY persistent signal, not on this one
controls.DELAYED_STATE: the benefit disappears under a realistic observation delay
controls.EXPOST_DIAGNOSTIC: how much of the ceiling is reachable only with hindsight
controls.USER_PRESET_REFERENCE: the supplied presets already do as well, retrospectively

registry.retention_rule: no control is dropped because it beats the proposed method (guide 10.2)
registry.staging_rule: controls are added in stages rather than as a full Cartesian product of every combination (guide 10.2)

RISK_ONLY.description: installed WFO selector on the frozen calendar
RISK_ONLY.note: arm A's own selections, resized by a scale calibrated on TRAINING observations of each state and clipped to [0.5, 1.0]. If this reproduces a dynamic arm's advantage, the advantage was exposure and not parameter selection

fidelity.why_it_matters: a placebo that switches far more often loses on transaction costs alone, and beating it would say nothing about the states. The control is only a control while the rates match (guide 10.2)

STATE_PLACEBO.generated_from: development-window dwell statistics only; no future label is shuffled in

CALENDAR_MATCHED.reason: the dynamic arms were given exactly the calendar's refresh count and training memory, so the calendar is already compute-matched to them. There is no separate run because there is no compute difference to control for

BANK_CALENDAR.reason: LAB-06 measured zero switches on the registered thresholds, so a bank that switches on the calendar and a bank that switches on regime deploy the same sequence. The control is retained and reported as degenerate rather than dropped (guide 10.2)

EXPOST_DIAGNOSTIC.reason: computed from returns that had not happened at decision time
